title: On the Pointwise Convergence of Solutions to the Schrödinger Equation Along Certain Highly Tangential Curves
summary: We investigate the Sobolev regularity required for almost everywhere convergence to the initial datum of solutions to the linear Schrödinger equation along certain tangential curves. In the regime $α<\tfrac12$, we analyze maximal estimates for expressions of the form $e^{itΔ}f(x+γ(t))$ over specific $α$-Hölder curves $γ$ and initial data $f\in H^s(\mathbb{R}^n)$. For the model family $γ(t)=(t^{α_1},\ldots,t^{α_n})$, where $α=\min_j α_j$, we show that the critical regularity is $s=\max\left\{\frac{1-2α}{2},\frac{n}{2(n+1)}\right\}.$
